hooks.name: brain-contract-guard

action.command: cd gateway && (npx tsc --noEmit || (echo "CONTRACT GUARD: gateway broke" && exit 1)) && if [ -d ../dashboard/node_modules ]; then cd ../dashboard && (npx tsc --noEmit || (echo "CONTRACT GUARD: dashboard broke" && exit 1)); fi

hooks.description: When a shared contract file is saved, type-check the gateway (and the dashboard if installed) so a schema change can't silently break another module.
